import sys, os

target=set()

    for line in f:

        if len(p)>=2:
            target.add(int(p[1]))

# sample header and order
header=open('data/raw_chr1_header.txt').read().rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
sample_order=header[9:]
sorted_samples=sorted(sample_order)
# for reordering just in case; likely identity
sample_idx={s:i for i,s in enumerate(sample_order)}
sorted_indices=[sample_idx[s] for s in sorted_samples]

acgt=set('ACGT')

def norm_gt(gt):
    # gt is first colon-separated field
    # Normalize any / or | and sort alleles
    parts=gt.replace('|','/').split('/')
    # If there are two alleles; strip potential trailing
    if len(parts)==2:
        a,b=parts
        if a in ('0','1') and b in ('0','1'):
            return '/'.join(sorted([a,b]))
    # allow unphased exact already maybe covered
    return './.'

records=[]
for line in sys.stdin:
    if line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    fields=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    if len(fields) < 10:
        continue
    chrom=fields[0]; pos=int(fields[1]); ref=fields[3]; alt=fields[4]
    if pos not in target:
        continue
    if ref not in acgt or alt not in acgt:
        continue
    # convert genotypes
    gts=[]
    for idx in sorted_indices:
        val=fields[9+idx]
        gt=val.split(':',1)[0]
        gts.append(norm_gt(gt))
    records.append((chrom,pos,ref,alt,gts))

records.sort(key=lambda x:x[1])

outpath='data/genotypes_chr1_common_top_peaks.tsv'

    f.write('CHROM\\tPOS\\tREF\\tALT\\t' + '\\t'.join(sorted_samples) + '\\n')
    for chrom,pos,ref,alt,gts in records:
        f.write(f'{chrom}\\t{pos}\\t{ref}\\t{alt}\\t' + '\\t'.join(gts) + '\\n')

import gzip, sys, bisect
peakfile='data/ENCFF717TCQ.bed.gz'
peaks=[]

    for line in f:
        p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        peaks.append((float(p[8]), p[0], int(p[1]), int(p[2])))
peaks.sort(key=lambda x:x[0], reverse=True)
chr1_intervals=sorted((x[2],x[3]) for x in peaks[:1000] if x[1]=='chr1')
starts=[a for a,b in chr1_intervals]
ends=[b for a,b in chr1_intervals]
acgt=set('ACGT')
out=open('data/snp151Common_chr1_biallelic_strict.tsv','w')
count=0
for line in sys.stdin:
    p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    if len(p)<10: continue
    chrom=p[1]; start=int(p[2]); observed=p[9]
    if chrom"'!='"'chr1': continue
    i=bisect.bisect_right(starts, start)-1
    if i>=0 and start < ends[i]:
        # Split observed into alleles, exactly two, each exactly one base A/C/G/T
        alleles=observed.split('/')
        if len(alleles)==2 and all(a in acgt for a in alleles) and alleles[0]"'!=alleles[1]:
            pos=start+1
            out.write(f"chr1'"\\t{pos}\\t.\\t{observed}\\n\")
            count+=1
out.close()
print(count, file=sys.stderr)
